tools.name: find_documentation
tools.description: Find the Docswrite page for a topic such as authentication, MCP, webhooks, pricing, WordPress or scheduling. Searches the llms.txt index and returns matching titles with URLs.

topic.description: What you are looking for, e.g. webhooks, ghost, pricing.

tools.name: get_api_catalog
tools.description: Fetch the Docswrite API catalog (RFC 9727 linkset): REST API, OpenAPI spec, MCP servers, OAuth metadata and docs.

tools.name: get_auth_guide
tools.description: Read how agents authenticate to the Docswrite API and MCP server: OAuth 2.1 with PKCE, org API keys, scopes, rate limits and errors (auth.md).

tools.name: get_pricing_plans
tools.description: Read Docswrite plans with monthly and yearly prices, connection limits, seats and what each plan excludes, as markdown from /pricing.md.

tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: List the blogs, CMSs and social networks Docswrite publishes to (WordPress, Webflow, Shopify, Ghost, Contentful, Medium, Dev.to, Hashnode, GitHub, X, LinkedIn...) with what each receives.

tools.name: navigate_to_page
tools.description: Navigate this tab to a Docswrite page such as /developers, /pricing, /sandbox, /accounts/signup or /dashboard/connections.

path.description: Site-relative path beginning with a slash.
